plan.rationale: The operation explicitly parses category mappings to left, middle, and right baskets and performs visually grounded grasp-and-place. RGB shows three open baskets and objects consistent with the requested categories. Bind chocolate_bar to the left white basket, wooden_toy to the middle blue basket, and car to the right red basket. Its observation/action-chunk contracts and end-effector representation fit the program-library composition. Unlike visual-attribute-placement, it honors language-specified destinations rather than assigning baskets by transfer cost. Resetting the arm is a shared lifecycle action after placement.
